description.text: Program Description Clinical Pharmacy separated from the hospital Pharmacy branches of science, is based on the patient object, in order to improve the quality of Clinical medicine, for the purpose of interaction between drugs and the body as the core, research and practice rational Clinical drug application methods of comprehensive application technology subject. Future Career Clinical pharmacy graduates, the employment direction is mainly in the various medical units, medical colleges and universities engaged in clinical pharmacy education, medicine circulation, adverse drug reaction monitoring, identification and drug research and development, pharmaceutical service and management. Tuition 5 years

duration.text: The Clinical Pharmacy in Chinese at China Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4444 USD/per year ￥ 32000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. High school graduate 3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
